children.value: > Fact From Story | Bankman-Fried co-founded crypto-trading firm Alameda Research in 2017.
> Fact From Story | Sam Bankman-Fried, the founder of failed cryptocurrency exchange FTX, is on trial for seven counts of wire fraud and conspiracy.
> > Fact From Story | FTX was a fraud “from the start,” the Securities and Exchange Commission alleges — with a “multi-billion-dollar deficiency caused by his own misappropriation of customer funds.”

> > > Fact From Story | The indictment also says that there were special features in FTX’s code that “permitted Alameda to spend and withdraw unlimited amounts of money from FTX,” which were created at Bankman-Fried’s direction.
> > > Fact From Story | Bankman-Fried is facing seven counts of criminal charges: two counts of wire fraud, and five counts of conspiracy charges.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge | Misappropriating funds is illegal.
> > Commonsense Knowledge | Fraud is a crime.
> Commonsense Knowledge | Trials are held to determine guilt or innocence.
